spans.s:
m. (-यः)
1 Conquest, victory, triumph.
2 A name of YUDHIṢṬ

HIRA.
3
A proper name, the son of

INDRA.
4

One of VIṢṆU'S doorkeepers.
5 The name of a king; also विजयनन्दन.
6 A kind of Mūṅg or bean, (Phaseolus mungo.)
f. (-या)
1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ.
2 One of her female companions.
3 The 3rd, 8th, or 13th lunar day of either half month.
4 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
5 A plant: see जयन्ती.
6 A tree, commonly Ganiyari, (Premna spinosa.)
7 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.)
8 A banner, a flag.
E.
जि to conquer or excel, affixes अच् and टाप्.

mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं)
Able to conquer, victorious.
E.
जि to subdue, affix यत्, deriv. irr.

f. (-या)
A wife, one wedded according to the perfect ritual.
E.
जन to be born, affix यक्; in whom a man is again born, that is to say, he is re-born in his children.

m. (-लः)
1 A kind of dice.
2 Shouts of victory.
E.
जय victory, कोलाहल a noise.

m. (-र्व्वः)
Pride of conquest, exultation.
E.
जय, and गर्व्व pride.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Conquering, excelling.
E.
जि to conquer, शतृ aff.

f. (-क्का)
A large kettle drum.
E.
जय, and ढक्का a drum.

m. (-त्तः)
The son of INDRA.
E.
जय victory, दत्त given, to whom victory is given by his enemies.

m. (-थः)
A chief in the army of DURYODHANA.

n. (-नं)
1 Armour for cavalry, elephants, &c.
2 Conquering, subduing.
f. (-नी)
INDRA'S daughter.
E.
जि to conquer or excel, affixes ल्युट् and ङीष्.

mfn. (-युक्)
1 Caparisoned, (as a war horse.)
2 Victorious.
E.
जयन, and युज् having.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A hero and demigod, the son of

INDRA.
2
A name of Ś

IVA.
3

The moon.
4 A name of BHĪMA.
(-न्ती)
1 A tree, (Aeschynomene sesban.)
2 A name of the goddess

DURGĀ.
3
The daughter of

INDRA.
4

A flag, a banner.
5 A particular combination in astronomy, or the rising of the asterism ROHIṆĪ at midnight, on the 8th of the dark half of Śrāvaṇa, or in fact on the birth day of KṚṢṆA, which is then particularly sacred.
6 Blades of barley planted at the commencement of the Daśaharā, and plucked at its close.
E.
जि to conquer or excel, Uṇādi affix झच्, fem. affix ङीष्.

n. (-त्रं)
Record of victory or triumph; in law, the sealed and written award of the judge in favour of either party; in historical tradition, the label on the brow of a horse turned loose for the Aśvamedha sacrifice.
E.
जय conquest, and पत्र a leaf; also with वन added जयपत्रक.

m. (-लः)
1 A name of

BRAHMA.
2
VIṢṆ

A king, a sovereign; (it is also the appellation of several celebrated Hindu princes.)
4 A tree, (Croton tiglium.)
E.
जय victory, पाल who nourishes.

m. (-निः)
Shout of victory.
E.
जय, and ध्वनि sound.

m. (-कः)
A kind of dice.

m. (-लः)
The royal elephant.
E.
जय victory, and मङ्गल good fortune.

m. (-ज्ञः)
The Aśvamedha or sacrifice of a horse, as a mark of dominion.
E.
जय, and यज्ञ sacrifice.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Conferring victory.
2 Victorious.
E.
जय, and वह what bears.

Victorious.
2

Conferring victory.
E.
जय, and आवह what gives.

f. (-नी)
The wife of INDRA.
E.
जय conquest, and वाहिनी who bears.

m. (-ब्दः)
A shout or song of victory, or the exclamation Jaya Jaya repeated like the Io of the Greeks, as जयजयदेवहरे &c.
E.
जय, and शब्द sound.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Victorious, triumphant.
E.
जय, and शील possessed.

f. (-श्रीः)
Victory, glory.
E.
जय, and श्री splendor.

m. (-यः)
An impediment or hindrance to victory.
E.
जय, and अन्तराय obstacle.

m. (-वः)
The Io or song of victory: see जयशब्द.
E.
जय, and आरव sound.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Victorious.
E.
जय victory, इनि aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Victorious, conquering.
E.
जय, and उद्धुर firm.

f. (-ता)
Victory, success, ability to conquer.
E.
जय्य, and तल् affix; also with त्व, जय्यत्वं.

n. (-कं)
A yellow fragrant wood.
E.
जि to excel (all perfumes), and ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being born, coming into life.
E.
जन to be born, शानच् aff.

m. (-घ्नः)
1 A murderer of his wife.
2 A mole or mark on the body, indicative of the death of a wife.
E.
जाया, and घ्न what destroys.

m. (-वः)
An actor, a dancer.
E.
जाया a wife, and जीव who gets a livelihood.

n. (-त्वं)
The character or attributes of a wife.
E.
जाया, and त्व aff.

m. (-वी)
1 An actor, a dancer, a mine, &c.
2 A kind of crane, the Vaka (Ardea nivea.)
3 A needy man, a pauper.
4 The husband of a harlot.
E.
जाया a wife, अनु like or with, and जीविन् who gets a livelihood; who is supported by his wife.

m. du. (-ती)
Husband and wife.
E.
जाया a wife, and पति husband.

m. (-युः)
A medicine, a medicament.
E.
जि to subdue, (disease,) Uṇādi affix उण्.
